204     @staticmethod
205     def _add_tool_result_into_chat_history(chat_history, func, result):
206         """
207         Add the result of tool calls into messages.
208         """
209         return chat_history.extend([
210             {
211                 "role": "assistant",
212                 "content": [
213                     {
214                         "type": "tool_use",
215                         "id": func.id,
216                         "name": func.name,
217                         "input": func.input,
218                     },
219                 ]
220             },
221             {
222                 "role": "user",
223                 "content": [
224                     {
225                         "type": "tool_result",
226                         "tool_use_id": func.id,
227                         "content": result,
228                     },
229                 ]
230             },
231         ])
232 
233     def query(self, chat_history, **kwargs):
234         """
235         Query the LLM model.
236 
237         Args:
238             chat_history: The context (chat history).
239         """
240         # claude has not system role in chat_history
241         # https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/system-prompts
242         system_prompt = ""
243         for idx, msg in enumerate(chat_history):
244             if msg["role"] == "system":
245                 system_prompt += msg["content"]
246 
247         # claude does not support mannual `response_format`, so we append it into system prompt
248         if "response_format" in kwargs.keys():
249             system_prompt += (
250                 f"\nOutputs only valid {kwargs['response_format']['type']} without any explanatory words"
251             )
252 
253         # mapping the openai function_schema to claude tool_schema
254         tools = kwargs.get("functions",[])
255         for tool in tools:
256             if "parameters" in tool.keys():
257                 tool["input_schema"] = tool["parameters"]
258                 del tool["parameters"]
259 
260         completion = self.client.messages.create(
261             max_tokens=4096,
262             model=self.model,
263             system=system_prompt,
264             messages=[msg for msg in chat_history if msg["role"] != "system"],
265             temperature=self.temperature,
266             stream=False,
267             tools=tools,
268         )
269         if completion.stop_reason == "tool_use":
270             for func in completion.content:
271                 if func.type != "tool_use":
272                     continue
273                 function_name = process_function_name(func.name)
274                 arguments = func.input
275                 print("[MLE FUNC CALL]: ", function_name)
276                 self.func_call_history.append({"name": function_name, "arguments": arguments})
277                 # avoid the multiple search function calls
278                 search_attempts = [item for item in self.func_call_history if item['name'] in SEARCH_FUNCTIONS]
279                 if len(search_attempts) > 3:
280                     kwargs['functions'] = []
281                 result = get_function(function_name)(**arguments)
282                 self._add_tool_result_into_chat_history(chat_history, func, result)
283                 return self.query(chat_history, **kwargs)
284         else:
285             return completion.content[0].text
286 
287     def stream(self, chat_history, **kwargs):
288         """
289         Stream the output from the LLM model.
290         Args:
291             chat_history: The context (chat history).
292         """
293         # claude has not system role in chat_history
294         # https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/system-prompts
295         system_prompt = ""
296         for idx, msg in enumerate(chat_history):
297             if msg["role"] == "system":
298                 system_prompt += msg["content"]
299         chat_history = [msg for msg in chat_history if msg["role"] != "system"]
300 
301         # claude does not support mannual `response_format`, so we append it into system prompt
302         if "response_format" in kwargs.keys():
303             system_prompt += (
304                 f"\nOutputs only valid {kwargs['response_format']['type']} without any explanatory words"
305             )
306 
307         with self.client.messages.stream(
308             max_tokens=4096,
309             model=self.model,
310             messages=chat_history,
311         ) as stream:
312             for chunk in stream.text_stream:
313                 yield chunk
